doc: Entity spawn/registration dispatcher keyed by entity type a0. If the type is 0x38 (56), first runs two housekeeping passes over the D_80083D08[6] slot table (func_800481E0 marks status bit0 for active flags; func_80047C00 zeroes flagged slots). Then looks up or allocates the entity's data slot via func_80047CD8(a0); if a slot pointer was obtained, runs func_8003F320's processing loop once and dispatches initialization to func_80047EEC(0x38, p) for type 0x38 or func_80047FF4(a0, p) for any other type.
